figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. (A) Structures of compounds 1 and 2. (B) HPLC profiles of
extracts of a culture medium from an A. oryzae transformant harboring
TlnA. (C) GC-MS analysis of TlnA reaction products with GGPP.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. (A) Energy profile of the intermediate i to iv carbocation
cascade. The relative potential energy is calculated at the M062X/6-
31G* level of theory. The energy in parentheses is the Gibbs free
energy refined at the M062X/6-311++G** level of theory. (B) Key
geometric parameters, which are the dihedral, angle, and distance.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. (A) Binding mode of intermediate i in TlnA optimized at
the M062X/6-31G* level of theory. Amino acids are shown as green
sticks, substrates as cyan sticks, positively charged carbon atoms as
orange spheres, and cation−π interactions as black dashed lines. The
distance is given in angstroms. (B) Key dihedral angles, bond angles,
and distances in i from the optimization.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. (A) Interaction energy differences assessed by the residue
preferences for conformation i-A or i-B. The green bars indicate that
i-A is favored, while the red bars indicate that i-B is favored. (B and
C) Distances in conformations i-A and i-B, respectively. (D)
Alignment of the isopropyl group containing positively charged C15
in i-A with the isopropyl group in i-B. The carbon atoms in i-A and i-
B are colored purple and cyan, respectively, while the active pocket is
rendered as a gray surface. Others are colored and rendered in the
same style as in Figure 3.

figure_candidates.label: Scheme 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Scheme 1. Mechanism of Cyclization of 1 (talarodine), 2,
and Fusicocca-2,10(14)-diene

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. (A) Schematic diagram of the p orbital of positively charged
C15 and the C14−H14 σ-bond. (B) Transition state structure of the
hydride transfer reaction, the unoccupied lone pair* NBO on C15,
and the occupied σ NBO on the C14−H14 bond. The distance
between hydrogens on C19 and C13 is shown as a black dashed line,
and the value is given in angstroms. Red and blue represent positive
and negative phases of orbitals, respectively. (C) Optimized structure
of intermediate i with ang unchanged as in i-B and dih2 fixed to 95.8°,
the unoccupied lone pair* NBO on C15, and the occupied σ NBO on
the C14−H14 bond. (D) Energy profile of the hydride transfer. The
relative potential energy involved is calculated at the M062X/6-31G*
level of theory. The energy in parentheses is the Gibbs free energy
refined at the M062X/6-311++G** level of theory.
